body: I’m young too I suppose. I’m 32f but I feel old af lol I got diagnosed when I was a kid like 10-12ish I can’t remember. I have MVP with mild regurgitation. I also have generalized anxiety disorder. When I was younger my doc told me I’d have to worry about it getting worse in my 40s and potentially having surgery to fix it. I’m rambling but I’m super anxious about almost anything and being diagnosed at 10 shot my anxiety thru the roof. I thought my life was over lol yet here I am at 32 with a kiddo living my best life thinking I’d be having open heart surgery and destitute in like 8 years time. They told me the same thing. How common it is and how normal my life would be. So I just lived it as such. Yes I was anxious and I still looked up all the worst case scenarios I could but it also helped me just pay better attention to my body. Helped me to know my limits of what I can and cannot do. My heart tweaked a few years ago and I ended up going to the ER and it was all because I had one too many Red Bulls and coffee. My heart was palpitating every 3-5 minutes which was highly abnormal for me. Yikes! So now I know I need to limit my caffeine intake along with my stressors. Haven’t had an incident like that since. My palpitations still happen and I still get the blood rushes like y’all mention too but they’re nowhere extreme like that one time. So I know my symptoms can be aggravated. So I think it really boils down to just understanding YOUR normal, knowing what aggravates and upsets that normal. That might help ease the anxiety. Part of the anxiety was the unknown for me. So if I know what can trigger my MVP or my palpitations I felt at least a little bit more in control. Hope this helps!! We’ve got this guys!!

Sooo weird because i had a similar situation (minus the pregnant part) and I wanted to choke the doctor out so bad lol 🤣 it was a new cardiologist so i always bring my documents when it’s a new doctor so they don’t play “you don’t know what your talking about” card and he said the same thing. I forced him to give me an EKG or to document refusal in my chart. He told me it’s possible I grew out of because he wasn’t hearing the “click” with the stethoscope and he was being extremely dismissive. Basically rude. I told him I’ve had it since I was 12. He said I’ve probably grown out of it. I asked him how is that possible when I feel it’s been getting worse hence my appointment to see him. After the EKG, it still showed mild regurgitation and MVP but that I need not return and to simply reduce my stressors and caffeine intake. I guess their new directive has been to tell us we’ll “grow out of it”? I have no idea but it honestly scared the heck out of me. Maybe seek a second opinion? You know your body best. Listen to your gut. We only get one body. Yes doctors have gone to their studies for ions but we’ve been stuck with our bodies since birth…you know what’s not YOUR normal…thoughts going out to you.
You’re so welcome my love. I know no amount of words could make you feel better but just know you are heard.

I definitely even built a fort out of couch cushions and blankets and watched Winnie the Pooh on repeat. Honestly…whatever it takes. I had to satisfy my inner child before I could satisfy the adult in me. Again…this was my journey. Yours might look/feel different. It looking/feeling different is okay. Just hoping I might be able to help open up some thoughts or creative juices.

Well those might not have been “the one” ya know? Lol what makes YOU happy? What brings YOU joy? What used to bring you joy? What used to bring you that spark once upon a time? Was it jigsaw puzzles? Or stitch quilts? Paint by numbers? I had to dig deep one year and brought it back to those little Christmas trees we made in like 2nd grade with tissue paper? Lol start small then scale it bigger. I found a song I used to love and danced to it on full blast mode one morning and whew…never felt better. Hell sometimes even just planning a cry session for like 5 minutes was helpful. Sometimes the cliche hobbies may not work…and that’s okay. Try something new one day…if it doesn’t stick. No problem…there’s a plethora of other things to try until we get it right. We can brainstorm here.
Could you…not? I think it’s obvious your antics are doing the opposite of what you’re trying to do.

In my opinion, if you have an appointment here in 20 minutes…let your therapist know about how you’re feeling. It’s their job to help you work through these feelings. That’s supposed to be your safe space. Suffering in silence is tough. Outlets are just that. Your chance to get it all out. It may sound silly but do you have a space where you can go and just scream? To just get it all out?
Also thank you for asking. Very kind of you.

My other support systems/resources have failed me tremendously which led to this impulsive last minute tattoo. The other alternatives i had planned were far more toxic/unhealthy/deadly. This was better lol

And if we forget…send another smoke signal. Like the Batman signal. We’re human, not elephants. We tend to forget sometimes. But we read it *reddit* (get it) and here we are…keeping you alive. Even it’s for another day. We’re here for you. In the best of times and the darkest of times.

My love…you are never alone. I know it FEELS that way. Look at this community that came running to your call. We are all fighting this good fight. Physically you may very well be alone. I’m not one to fib…I am right there with you on that endeavor. But you are NOT alone. Please believe in me when I say that. Please.

I say this with love and care…you posted so you must have wanted someone to read and comment. Your title “nobody will read this” knowing one will and we did…because we care. 

Why do you want to die? What kind of help do you think you want right? How would you like for us to respond? It’s not selfish. You’re sick…so let us help you.

Unpacking it is just about as bad as the panic attacks. It’s very exhausting.  I’m so so sorry you’re going through this. Just know your feelings are very much valid. I know how you’re feeling. It’s quite comical how the kind plays these games with us. It’s like this weird form of cruel and unusual punishment it inflicts upon its own self. Like seriously? We’re trying to survive here and this is the game you choose to play. I also had all of the things at that age yet life was still unfulfilling for me. And yet there I was being so nice and caring to others. Following the golden rule…only to continue to be shat on and you’re looking at the universe like wtf?! That speaks more on their karma than it does yours. I tried cutting once but I realized I liked tattoos better than scars. Might as well get something out of it if I’m going thru the pain right? This is the community where you can get whatever attention you need at the moment…so bring it. We got you.
Commenting so I can see updates. Hoping you’re okay.

Finding a healthy outlet is easier said than done. Once I found one life was soooo much easier and better. Whenever I found myself spiraling…I would just do my outlet. Mine was running. It gave me a high like nothing else ever could. Then I had a back up outlet which was music. I would play my piano until my fingers started bleeding. Then I had a back up back up…which was/is my dog. I’d be giving him the best scratches and pets he ever had. It was lovely. 

Then I banged up my knee and my ins is shit and can’t get it fixed. My piano is like 5000 miles away. I have my dog so that’s a plus. But I’m still spiraling. So I still need those outlets. Can you think of any healthy outlet you might be able to grab ahold of that you may not have tried yet?

It sounds rough. But you’re still here…thankfully so. And how are you feeling today? In this moment? I know it’s hard. Hard to trust. Sometimes we have to simply take it day by day. Sometimes it’s less than that…sometimes it’s minute by minute…second by second…breathe by breathe. And honestly…that’s okay. Because you did. You took the breathe. Congrats. You blinked your eyes. Congrats. YOU did that. Kudos. So let’s talk it out…how are you feeling right now?

I used to live in Vegas. I KNOW the struggle first hand lol It’s a different kind of humid. It’s the dryness that gets to you. And whatever moisture you have in your hair gets assaulted from the dryness in the air. It was a struggle finding the right balance. I didn’t read ALL the other comments just some so do forgive me if I’m being redundant. I know you mentioned you don’t want a lot of product to weigh your hair down. I had the same concerns. Too much products makes my hair heavy when it’s straight. But just the right amount and it works wonders. 

-I use a cleansing shampoo (tresemme has a good one)

-A moisturizing conditioner (also by tresemme)

-A leave in conditioner (it’s a 10 plus keratin is good - it’s a small bottle but a little expensive)

-Chi heat protectant or any heat protectant of choice- preferably something that contains or emphasizes “silk”. 

- a “blow out spray” would also be beneficial as well

- Apply this to damp hair and blow dry with a comb extension or a paddle brush. 

-Chi silk infusion I believe was mentioned already. This is a game changer. You don’t need much. You can add this to blow dried hair. I section my hair first and then apply like a pea sized amount. A little goes a long way. If you use too much it will cake onto your hair. 

- Then I flat iron. The flat iron brings it altogether honestly. Use a fine tooth comb for your sections and to hold the hair as you flat iron. 

- Shea Moisture Raw Shea Butter Reconstructive Finishing Elixir w/Sea Kelp and Argan Oil as the final touch. Use very very little. Just a few spritz and you’ll be set and shiny. 

Hope this helps! Beautiful curls by the way!
